acceptance_predicates.description: Two consecutive invocations of plain `make install` into the same validated prefix succeed without an extra Make option.
Overwrite behavior is passed only to Cargo's install operation; documentation and diagnostics never instruct the user to run the invalid `make install --force` form.
Only the managed ASB executable is replaced, while unrelated prefix contents and every existing path/symlink safety boundary remain intact.
Deterministic tests fail without the Cargo overwrite flag and cover repeated default-HOME and explicit-prefix installation plus negative path cases.
The exact signed+DCO candidate receives independent review, green exact-head CI, a signed reviewed-tree merge, and green exact-main CI.

definition_of_done: The current-main existing-destination and invalid Make-option failure is reproduced and repaired without changing the user-facing command.
Focused Makefile tests and all applicable locked workspace gates pass at unchanged thresholds.
A privacy-safe receipt binds the reviewed candidate, signed merge, and post-merge verification before the AR is released done.

inputs.description: AR-1745 user-local prefix implementation and its idempotent reinstall requirement.
The exact protected-main Make install target and bounded Makefile test harness.

outputs.description: A safe plain `make install` path that replaces an existing ASB executable within the validated prefix.
Deterministic default and explicit-prefix reinstall tests retaining all negative safety coverage.
Exact candidate, review, CI, merge, and post-merge evidence.

gates.description: Repeated default and explicit-prefix installs succeed and remain bounded to the validated destination.
Focused Makefile coverage and applicable locked Rust, policy, documentation, and supply-chain gates pass unchanged.
Independent review, exact-head CI, signed exact-tree integration, and exact-main CI all pass.
